artworks.title: La retour (The Return)
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts two figures, one on the left and one on the right. The figure on the left is a bearded man wearing a cap and a long coat. The figure on the right has hair tied up or covered and is holding a basket or bag. There are other distant figures in the background along with some objects on the ground, possibly luggage or boxes. The background suggests an outdoor setting with faint outlines of structures or a landscape.

artworks.title: Au front de Champagne - Les dernieres prieres
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural landscape with two figures standing in open land. One figure holds an object resembling a book or paper, while the other faces them with a similar object. In the background, there are faint indications of fields or trenches, creating a solemn atmosphere. The figures wear long garments, suggesting a ceremonial gathering. Light pencil strokes create a minimalistic style capturing a scene of anticipation or reflection.

artworks.title: Choisissez vos chambres
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush with black and gray ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two groups of figures. On the left, a group of figures is clustered together facing the viewer's right side. They are wearing helmets and carrying large packs, suggestive of a military context. On the right in the foreground, a solo figure stands facing the group on the left. This figure is also dressed in a uniform with a helmet and a long coat, gripping something that extends downward. The person has a mustache and beard, with simplified facial features. The sketch features loose and bold graphite lines for the figures and the rocky terrain. The background shows sketchy outlines of piles of rocks or debris in a rough landscape.

artworks.title: Le depart pour Versailles
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink over graphite on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting two figures primarily from the waist up. The figure on the left is seated, resting their head on a hand. They are wearing a long garment and a headscarf covering their hair. Their facial features are drawn with deep lines, suggesting an older age. Next to this figure, another person stands slightly turned away, holding a bag with their left hand. This second figure is taller, wearing a large robe or coat. Their head is bald or covered, with facial features sketched in a somewhat detailed manner. The background is plain with no distinct environment depicted.

artworks.title: Rassurez vous; je suis gauché.
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a scene. The drawing is rendered in charcoal or graphite, depicting two individuals. One figure is assisting the other who is reclining on the ground. The reclining figure appears distressed or in pain, indicated by their posture and facial expression. The surrounding elements suggest a rocky or rough terrain. The sketch captures a moment of urgency or care through dynamic poses and contrast between light and dark shading.

artworks.title: L'attaque d'une "place forte" anglaise
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in a dramatic scene. The image portrays a dynamic composition of figures against a stark backdrop. Central to the drawing is a figure kneeling with one arm raised, surrounded by others on the ground. The use of light and shadow enhances the tension, emphasizing emotions conveyed through postures and gestures. The image captures a moment of intense emotion, with a sense of movement illustrated through sweeping lines and energetic strokes.

artworks.title: French Soldier Addressing Germania
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink and black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two figures from the waist up. On the left, a figure wearing a helm is holding an object in front of them with both hands. The facial features are not detailed, with shadowed eyes and a defined jawline. The clothing suggests military attire with a wide collar. The figure on the right has a long face with sharp cheekbones, long flowing hair, and a helmet with a spike. The attire is loosely sketched with no clear detail. There are no visible accessories, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: German Advance
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink and blue and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a soldier in profile, facing left. The soldier is standing upright with one leg slightly forward and the left arm raised, pointing to the left. The soldier's facial features are partially obscured by a helmet and shadow. The soldier is dressed in a military uniform, including a helmet, coat, pants, and boots. A rifle is slung over the soldier's right shoulder, with a satchel or canteen hanging from their belt. In the background, there are vague outlines of distant figures and shapes against an open landscape. The setting is minimal, with a line suggesting the horizon or ground.

artworks.title: During the Armistice
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting figures in a contemplative scene. The drawing uses simple lines and shading to depict a set of figures within an undefined space. One figure stands with hands clasped, head tilted upward. The use of charcoal or pencil gives the piece a raw and expressive touch, emphasizing emotions rather than detailed realism. The surrounding figures and scenery are delineated with minimalistic lines. The strokes give the piece an open-ended narrative.

artworks.title: -Qu'est-ce vous voulez?  -Les "louis" de 1871
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals shown from head to toe. On the left, a person standing upright with their body facing forward but the head turned to the right, and hands behind their back. This person is wearing a helmet, long coat, and boots. On the right, another person standing with a slightly hunched posture, looking intently towards the person on the left. This person has more pronounced facial features with an open mouth and squinted eyes, wearing a spiked headdress, long robe, and bare feet. The surroundings are minimal with indistinct shapes resembling stones or rubble at the ankles of the second person, and an undefined form to the right of them. The background is a blank, textured surface, and the entire scene is sketched with loose, expressive lines.

artworks.title: Poilu Acknowledging German Soldier
artworks.medium: black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts two figures in conversation. One figure is seated on the left, wearing a helmet and coat, while the other stands on the right, wearing a cap and uniform. The background features loosely drawn lines hinting at a landscape. The sketch emphasizes expressive lines, focusing on the essential features of the figures. Shadows and textures are created through cross-hatching and smudging techniques.

artworks.title: L'heure des gothas
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink, with corrections by the artist in white opaque watercolor, on wove paper
artworks.description: This image shows a seated person holding a baby in their arms. The person is sitting on a chair, facing the baby with a gentle expression. The person has a bun hairstyle and is wearing a long dress with a shawl. The baby is wrapped in a patterned blanket. Next to them is a detailed bassinet or crib. The background includes a window and a faint hint of outdoors, and there is a small object, possibly a toy, on the floor.

artworks.title: Grace!
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a crawling position on the ground. The person's body is visible, with hands and knees touching the ground. The person's head is tilted back, mouth open. The facial features include an open mouth, but no other details are discernible. The person wears a helmet with a small protrusion and loose-fitting clothing. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is sparse with faint lines suggesting an open landscape with vague shapes in the distance, creating a sense of openness.

artworks.title: News in the Trenches
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a soldier in a crouched position. The soldier is hunched forward with bent knees, suggesting caution or taking cover. He wears a military helmet and uniform, holding a long object, possibly a rifle. Vague impressions of other soldiers or figures are behind him, with clouds or smoke on the right side. The background is lightly sketched, conveying a battlefield environment. The artwork is monochromatic with shading and minimal lines for dramatic effect.

They are dressed in a sleeveless garment. The figure on the right is seated, has a bald head, distinct facial features, and wears a dark suit. They are holding what appears to be a large bird. The background is plain with minimal sketch lines, and there are inscriptions in the upper left and below the figures.

artworks.title: Ceux de la premiere heure.  "Sire! ou en somme-nous de "la guerre fraiche et joyeuse"? ..."
artworks.medium: black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure draped in a flowing cloak. The sketch is minimalistic, using simple pencil lines and shading to depict the voluminous folds of a cloak worn by a bent-over figure. The background features subtle, sketchy lines suggesting a ground or surface, as well as some abstract circular shapes. The drawing captures movement and dynamic force with its use of lines and texture, showcasing the energy and grace of the subject.

artworks.title: A Versailles juillet 1919
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The sketch primarily shows two individuals with a focus on their upper bodies. On the left, a man with short hair and a mustache is depicted looking downward, possibly writing or reading. To his right, another man is leaning on a barrier or low wall. The background suggests an audience or crowd, with curved lines and some indistinct detailing resembling trees or structural elements.

artworks.title: Prussian Soldier and Civilians
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with two half-body representations of people. On the left, a person is leaning forward with their head slightly bowed, wearing a coat with a rounded collar. Their face is partially turned downward and they have short hair. On the right, another person is standing upright with their hands behind their back, wearing a helmet with a spike and a stylized mustache. The background is simple with a few horizontal lines, and there is an artist's signature in the bottom right corner.

b) black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two women in motion facing each other. The woman on the right stands upright, with long flowing hair and distinct facial features. She wears a flowing garment sketched in dark lines. The woman on the left is slightly bent, looking up at the other woman, partially obscured by a head covering. She also wears a flowing dress. The background includes simple outlines of buildings, rooftops and chimneys. The scene conveys a dynamic interaction between the two figures against a sparse backdrop.

artworks.title: Lost Illusions
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of two individuals. One person is lying on the ground, partly obscured by lines and shapes indicating debris. The other person is standing, leaning forward with one arm extended downward. They are wearing a hard hat and work attire. Facial features of the standing person, such as a beard, are visible. The background is minimally sketched.

artworks.title: After Douai
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures against a backdrop of a town with a church steeple. The drawing captures a scene in which one figure appears to comfort or support the other. The lines are expressive, using light and dark contrasts for movement and emotion. The background shows the outline of a town with buildings and a church steeple, suggesting a village or town setting. The use of space and line creates a narrative moment blending the figures' interaction with their surroundings in a minimalistic style.

artworks.title: The Departure for Versailles
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated and leaning slightly forward. They have a focused expression and are wearing a head covering. Their clothing includes layered garments, with the outer layer resembling a cloak. Next to them is a bag or suitcase. In the background, there is a faint sketch of another figure standing behind the seated person, holding a bag. The background is a light, uniform color.
